Mixer.dc.html.title: Mixer at half size over the editing panel

heading.text: mini daw: the landscape workspace of the MVP

scale.text:
1 px = 1 dp. Screen of the Galaxy A17 as measured in V-01: 891 × 411 dp, camera cutout 38 dp on the left; the app hides the system bars.

Sizes and colours follow ui_ux_specification.md Sections 1 to 10. Play the screens: the Module strip switches Piano roll and Channel Rack, the Mixer button opens and closes the Mixer, Play toggles.
